infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Cue records audio with your video and listens to help follow your script during rehearsal.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Cue matches on-device speech to your script so it can follow your pace.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Cue does not need access to your photos or videos to display or scroll your scripts.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Cue uses your camera to record video while you read your script.
